projects.description: Python 3.12 FastAPI service of the invented company Quillmoor Stays that issues invoices, collects payments through Stripe and exports accounting data.
Vue 3 + Vite web app in which hosts edit digital guidebooks and guests read them on their phones.
Go service that consumes booking events from channel managers through Kafka and loads them into ClickHouse for analytics.

memories.title: Primary database is PostgreSQL 15
memories.content: The billing API stores invoices, subscriptions and ledger entries in PostgreSQL 15 on RDS. SQLite is not supported even in tests because the ledger relies on Postgres advisory locks.
memories.keywords: postgres postgresql database rds advisory locks sqlite

memories.title: Run backend tests with uv run pytest -q
memories.content: Run the billing test suite with `uv run pytest -q` from the repository root. The docker compose db service must be running because the fixtures create one schema per xdist worker.
memories.keywords: pytest tests test suite xdist conftest

memories.title: Create Alembic migrations with autogenerate and review them
memories.content: Create schema migrations with `uv run alembic revision --autogenerate -m <slug>` and review the generated file, because autogenerate misses server defaults and enum value changes. Never edit a migration that is already on main; add a new one instead.
memories.keywords: alembic migration autogenerate schema enum server default

memories.title: Stripe webhook signatures are verified on the raw body
memories.content: Stripe webhooks arrive at POST /api/webhooks/stripe and are verified with STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET against the raw request body. Parsing the JSON before verification changes the bytes and makes every signature check fail.
memories.keywords: stripe webhook signature verification raw body secret

memories.title: Webhook handlers must be idempotent by Stripe event id
memories.content: Every Stripe webhook handler records the event id in processed_events and returns 200 for duplicates without repeating side effects. Stripe retries deliveries for up to three days, so a non-idempotent handler applies a payment twice.
memories.value_text: dedupe by Stripe event id in processed_events
memories.keywords: webhook idempotent retry duplicate processed_events event id

memories.title: Money is stored as integer minor units, never float
memories.content: Store and compute money as integer minor units (cents, halere) together with an ISO 4217 currency code; never use float. Convert to Decimal only at the API serialization boundary.
memories.keywords: money amount cents float decimal currency minor units

memories.title: Background jobs run on Celery with Redis 7
memories.content: Invoice generation, dunning e-mails and PDF rendering run as Celery tasks on the billing queue backed by Redis 7. The broker uses acks_late, so every task must be safe to run twice.
memories.keywords: celery redis background task queue worker acks_late

memories.title: Lint and format with ruff before committing
memories.content: Run `uv run ruff check --fix . && uv run ruff format .` before committing. CI fails on any ruff finding and on unformatted files.
memories.keywords: ruff lint format linter style

memories.title: mypy runs in strict mode without ignores
memories.content: The package is type-checked with `uv run mypy billing` in strict mode. Do not add type-ignore markers; fix the type or add a typed stub under stubs/.
memories.keywords: mypy typing type check strict stubs

memories.title: Deploys go to AWS ECS Fargate through GitHub Actions
memories.content: Merging to main runs .github/workflows/deploy.yml, which builds the image, pushes it to ECR and updates the ECS Fargate service billing-api-prod. There is no manual deploy path.
memories.keywords: deploy deployment ecs fargate ecr github actions production

memories.title: main is protected; merge through reviewed pull requests
memories.content: Nobody pushes directly to main in billing-api; work happens on <type>/<TICKET>/<slug> branches merged by pull request with one approval and green CI.
memories.value_text: feature branches and pull requests into main
memories.keywords: branch main protected pull request review merge push

memories.title: Runtime is Python 3.12
memories.content: The service runs on Python 3.12 from the python:3.12-slim base image. Avoid syntax and standard library APIs that only exist in 3.13.
memories.keywords: python version runtime docker base image

memories.title: Dependencies are managed with uv
memories.content: Add dependencies with `uv add <package>` and commit pyproject.toml together with uv.lock. Poetry was removed in March 2026 and its lock file must not come back.
memories.keywords: uv dependencies package manager poetry lock pyproject

memories.title: Configuration goes through pydantic-settings with the BILLING_ prefix
memories.content: Read configuration only through billing/settings.py, which uses pydantic-settings with the BILLING_ environment prefix. Modules never read os.environ directly.
memories.keywords: settings configuration environment variables pydantic env

memories.title: VAT rates come from the tax_rates table
memories.content: VAT rates are looked up in the tax_rates table by country and invoice date, never hard-coded. Finance maintains the table because rates change in the middle of a year.
memories.keywords: vat tax rate country invoice date finance

memories.title: Invoice numbers are gapless per calendar year
memories.content: Invoice numbers like INV-2026-000123 must be sequential without gaps per calendar year, as Czech accounting law requires. They are allocated in the transaction that finalizes the invoice, with a row lock on invoice_sequences.
memories.value_text: gapless per year with a row lock
memories.keywords: invoice number sequence gapless accounting law row lock

memories.title: Timestamps are stored as UTC timestamptz
memories.content: All timestamps are stored as timestamptz in UTC. Convert to the customer's timezone only when rendering documents and e-mails.
memories.keywords: timezone utc timestamp datetime

memories.title: Invoice PDFs are rendered with WeasyPrint
memories.content: Invoice PDFs are rendered from the Jinja templates in billing/templates/invoices with WeasyPrint. The Docker image needs the pango and harfbuzz packages, otherwise rendering silently falls back to wrong fonts.
memories.keywords: pdf invoice render weasyprint fonts pango jinja template

memories.title: Dunning e-mails go out on days 3, 7 and 14
memories.content: After a failed charge, dunning e-mails are sent on days 3, 7 and 14, and then the subscription moves to past_due. The schedule is defined in billing/dunning.py.
memories.keywords: dunning failed payment reminder email past_due subscription

memories.title: Breaking API changes need a new /api/v2 router
memories.content: Public endpoints live under /api/v1, and breaking changes go into a new /api/v2 router instead of changing a v1 response shape. Mobile clients pin the API version and cannot be force-updated.
memories.keywords: api version v1 v2 breaking change router mobile clients

memories.title: API errors use RFC 9457 problem details
memories.content: Return API errors as application/problem+json (RFC 9457) with type, title, status and detail. Bare strings and ad-hoc error objects break the clients' error handling.
memories.keywords: error response problem json rfc 9457 exception handler

memories.title: Build test data with factory_boy factories
memories.content: Create test data with the factories in tests/factories.py instead of instantiating models by hand. The factories set valid currency and tax-country defaults that hand-built models usually miss.
memories.keywords: factory_boy factories test data fixtures models

memories.title: Freeze time in tests with time-machine
memories.content: Date-dependent tests use the time_machine.travel fixture. freezegun was removed because it broke pydantic datetime validation.
memories.keywords: freeze time freezegun time_machine dates tests clock

memories.title: Start db, redis and stripe-mock with docker compose
memories.content: Run `docker compose up -d db redis stripe-mock` before starting the API or the tests. The stripe-mock container answers Stripe API calls offline on port 12111.
memories.keywords: docker compose local development stripe-mock redis database start

memories.title: Feature flags are evaluated with Unleash
memories.content: Feature flags are evaluated with the Unleash client wrapped in billing/flags.py. New flags default to off and are removed within two releases after full rollout.
memories.keywords: feature flag toggle unleash rollout

memories.title: Log with structlog and never log card data
memories.content: Log with structlog bound to request_id and account_id. Never log card data, full IBANs or raw webhook payloads.
memories.keywords: logging structlog log request_id card iban payload

memories.title: 2026-08 incident: N+1 queries on the invoice list
memories.content: In August 2026 the invoice list endpoint ran one query per invoice line and timed out for large accounts. The fix was selectinload on Invoice.lines, and the endpoint now has a query-count test.
memories.keywords: n+1 queries performance invoice list selectinload timeout sqlalchemy

memories.title: 2026-06 incident: double charges from a retried Celery task
memories.content: In June 2026 a Celery retry re-ran a charge after a network timeout and charged 41 customers twice. Charges now send a Stripe idempotency key derived from the invoice id.
memories.value_text: Stripe idempotency key from the invoice id
memories.keywords: double charge retry idempotency key stripe celery incident

memories.title: Supported currencies are CZK, EUR and GBP
memories.content: The billing API accepts CZK, EUR and GBP only. Adding a currency needs a tax_rates migration and sign-off from finance.
memories.keywords: currency currencies czk eur gbp

memories.title: VAT is rounded half-even per invoice line
memories.content: Compute VAT per invoice line and round half-even to the currency's minor unit. Rounding only the total produced one-cent mismatches with the accounting export.
memories.keywords: vat rounding half-even invoice line cent mismatch

memories.title: Nightly Pohoda XML export to the finance bucket
memories.content: A Celery beat job exports finalized invoices as Pohoda XML to the finance S3 bucket every night at 02:00 Europe/Prague. Finance imports the file at 06:00, so a failed export must be re-run before then.
memories.keywords: accounting export pohoda xml finance s3 nightly beat

memories.title: Internal callers use short-lived service JWTs
memories.content: Internal services authenticate to the billing API with service JWTs issued by the platform auth service. Validate the audience billing-api and reject tokens older than five minutes.
memories.keywords: auth authentication jwt token service audience internal

memories.title: Flaky dunning test is probably a timezone issue (unconfirmed)
memories.content: test_dunning_schedule fails intermittently on CI shortly after midnight UTC, most likely because its fixture uses date.today() in the runner's timezone. This is a hypothesis; nobody has reproduced it locally yet.
memories.keywords: flaky test dunning timezone midnight ci date.today

memories.title: Raw SQL only inside billing/repositories
memories.content: Raw SQL is allowed only in billing/repositories; services and routers call repository functions. This keeps the advisory-lock logic in one place.
memories.keywords: raw sql query repository layer service advisory lock

memories.title: Issue refunds through RefundService.create
memories.content: Refunds go through RefundService.create, which creates a credit note and then calls Stripe. Never call stripe.Refund.create directly, because the accounting export needs the credit note.
memories.keywords: refund credit note stripe refund service

memories.title: List endpoints paginate with an opaque cursor
memories.content: Collection endpoints return next_cursor and accept cursor and limit parameters, with limit capped at 100. Offset pagination was dropped because it skipped rows while invoices were being finalized.
memories.keywords: pagination cursor limit offset list endpoint next_cursor

memories.title: Customers manage their cards in the Stripe customer portal
memories.content: Customers update payment methods in the Stripe customer portal; the API creates a portal session at /api/v1/portal-sessions and returns its URL. The return_url must match an entry in PORTAL_RETURN_URL_ALLOWLIST.
memories.keywords: stripe customer portal payment method card session return_url

memories.title: Upgrades prorate immediately, downgrades wait for the period end
memories.content: Plan upgrades are charged immediately with Stripe proration_behavior=always_invoice, while downgrades are scheduled for the end of the current billing period. Support cannot change this per customer.
memories.value_text: upgrades prorated now, downgrades at period end
memories.keywords: proration upgrade downgrade plan change subscription period

memories.title: Trials last 14 days and need no card
memories.content: New accounts get a 14-day trial without a payment method. Three days before the trial ends the customer gets a reminder, and an account that still has no card is paused rather than charged.
memories.keywords: trial period free trial card reminder paused account

memories.title: Credit notes use their own CN- number series
memories.content: Credit notes are numbered like CN-2026-000045 from the credit_note_sequences table, separately from invoices. Never reuse an invoice number for a credit note, even when it cancels that invoice completely.
memories.keywords: credit note number series sequence cancel invoice

memories.title: Invoice PDFs are stored in S3 and shared through presigned links
memories.content: Rendered invoice PDFs are stored in the quillmoor-invoices bucket under {account_id}/{invoice_number}.pdf. Customers download them through presigned URLs that expire after 15 minutes.
memories.keywords: pdf invoice s3 bucket presigned url download storage

memories.title: Transactional e-mails go through Postmark templates
memories.content: Invoice, receipt and dunning e-mails are sent through Postmark using template aliases such as invoice-issued and dunning-first. The support team edits template copy in Postmark, not in the repository.
memories.keywords: email transactional postmark template alias receipt copy

memories.title: The public API allows 600 requests per minute per key
memories.content: The public API allows 600 requests per minute per API key, counted in a sliding window. Clients over the limit get 429 with a Retry-After header; internal service tokens are exempt.
memories.value_text: 600 requests per minute per API key
memories.keywords: rate limit 429 retry-after requests per minute api key

memories.title: Customer API keys are stored hashed with a visible prefix
memories.content: Customer API keys start with qmk_live_ followed by 32 random characters; only the SHA-256 hash and the first eight characters are stored. A lost key cannot be shown again and must be rotated in the dashboard.
memories.keywords: api key customer hash prefix rotate dashboard

memories.title: Regenerate openapi.json with make openapi
memories.content: After changing a route or a response model, run `make openapi` and commit the regenerated openapi.json. CI compares the file with the running app and fails when it is stale.
memories.keywords: openapi schema json generate routes response model ci

memories.title: Each API worker opens at most 15 database connections
memories.content: The async SQLAlchemy engine uses pool_size=10 and max_overflow=5 per Uvicorn worker. Raising either value without checking the instance's connection limit caused refused connections during the September load test.
memories.keywords: database connection pool sqlalchemy pool_size max_overflow worker

memories.title: Liveness is /healthz, readiness is /readyz
memories.content: /healthz only proves that the process answers, while /readyz also pings the database and Redis. The load balancer target group uses /readyz, so a slow database takes tasks out of rotation.
memories.keywords: health check liveness readiness healthz readyz load balancer

memories.title: Exceptions go to Sentry with PII sending disabled
memories.content: Unhandled exceptions are reported to Sentry with send_default_pii=False and a before_send hook that strips request bodies. Do not attach invoice objects as extra context.
memories.keywords: sentry exceptions error reporting pii before_send scrubbing

memories.title: Subscription status changes go through the state machine
memories.content: Change a subscription's status only with SubscriptionStateMachine.transition, which validates the move and writes an audit row. Assigning subscription.status directly skips both.
memories.keywords: subscription status state machine transition audit

memories.title: Discounts are percent-off coupons only
memories.content: Discounts map to Stripe coupons with percent_off only; amount_off coupons are rejected because one coupon would need a separate amount per currency. A coupon applies to at most 12 billing periods.
memories.keywords: discount coupon promo code percent off stripe

memories.title: Invoice language follows the account's billing locale
memories.content: Invoice PDFs and e-mails use the account's billing_locale, which can be cs, en or de. The locale is copied onto the invoice at finalization, so changing it later does not alter issued documents.
memories.value_text: account billing_locale: cs, en or de
memories.keywords: invoice language locale czech english german translation

memories.title: Reverse charge applies only to verified EU business customers
memories.content: Invoices for business customers in another EU country carry no VAT and the reverse-charge note, but only when their VAT ID passed VIES verification. Without a verified ID the domestic treatment applies.
memories.value_text: EU B2B with a verified VAT ID
memories.keywords: reverse charge vat id vies eu business b2b invoice

memories.title: Foreign-currency invoices also show VAT in CZK
memories.content: An invoice issued in a foreign currency must also state the VAT amount in CZK, converted at the CNB rate valid on the day of the taxable supply. The rate is fetched once a day into the fx_rates table.
memories.value_text: VAT also in CZK at the CNB rate
memories.keywords: foreign currency exchange rate cnb czk vat conversion

memories.title: Ledger postings must balance
memories.content: Every ledger transaction consists of debit and credit lines whose sum is zero; a deferred constraint trigger rejects unbalanced postings at commit. Never update a posted line; post a reversing transaction instead.
memories.keywords: ledger debit credit posting balance reversing transaction

memories.title: Merge duplicate accounts with make merge-accounts
memories.content: Duplicate customer accounts are merged with `make merge-accounts FROM=<id> INTO=<id>`, which is a dry run unless APPLY=1 is set. It moves subscriptions and invoices but never touches the Stripe customers.
memories.value_text: make merge-accounts, dry run by default
memories.keywords: merge duplicate accounts script dry run subscriptions

memories.title: Erasure requests anonymise contact data but keep invoices
memories.content: A GDPR erasure request replaces the customer's name, e-mail and address with placeholders but keeps invoices and amounts, which accounting law requires for ten years. Run it through the erase_customer admin action.
memories.value_text: anonymise contact data, keep invoices ten years
memories.keywords: gdpr erasure anonymise personal data retention accounting

memories.title: Every back-office action writes an audit event
memories.content: Each back-office mutation records an audit_events row with the actor, the action and a JSON diff. Admin endpoints without the @audited decorator fail the architecture test.
memories.keywords: audit log admin back office actor action decorator

memories.title: Back-office endpoints require the billing_admin role
memories.content: Endpoints under /admin require the billing_admin role from the staff SSO token, checked by the require_role dependency. Staff with the support role can read accounts but cannot change them.
memories.keywords: admin role permission staff sso support authorization

memories.title: The Stripe endpoint subscribes to invoice, subscription and refund events
memories.content: The webhook endpoint in the Stripe dashboard is subscribed to invoice.*, customer.subscription.* and charge.refunded. Other event types never arrive, so a new handler also needs the dashboard subscription.
memories.keywords: stripe webhook event types subscription dashboard handler

memories.title: The Stripe API version is pinned in billing/stripe_client.py
memories.content: billing/stripe_client.py pins the Stripe API version to 2025-09-30 and sets a 20-second timeout. Upgrading the version needs a run of the contract tests against the Stripe sandbox first.
memories.keywords: stripe api version client timeout upgrade sandbox

memories.title: Invoices are due 14 days after issue
memories.content: Invoices are due 14 days after issue; finance can switch enterprise accounts to 30 days. Overdue bank-transfer invoices are listed in the weekly receivables report.
memories.keywords: due date payment terms overdue receivables bank transfer

memories.title: Bank transfers are matched by variable symbol
memories.content: Bank transfer payments are imported hourly from the Lindenbank API and matched to invoices by variable symbol. Unmatched payments land in the payments_unmatched queue, where finance assigns them by hand.
memories.value_text: hourly import matched by variable symbol
memories.keywords: bank transfer payment matching variable symbol import unmatched

memories.title: Every response carries an X-Request-ID
memories.content: A middleware reuses the caller's X-Request-ID or generates a UUID4 and echoes it in the response. Support asks customers for this id when they report a failed call.
memories.keywords: request id header middleware uuid correlation support

memories.title: Plan lookups are cached for 60 seconds
memories.content: Account plan and entitlement lookups are cached in Redis for 60 seconds under keys prefixed billing:plan:. A plan change deletes the key in the same request, so stale entitlements never outlive a change.
memories.keywords: cache redis plan entitlement ttl invalidation

memories.title: Only draft invoices can be edited
memories.content: Invoice lines, totals and the customer snapshot can change only while the invoice is a draft. finalize() freezes them, and any later correction needs a separate document.
memories.keywords: invoice draft finalize edit lines immutable

memories.title: Load demo accounts with make seed
memories.content: `make seed` loads demo accounts, plans and a year of invoices into the local database so the dashboard has data to show. It refuses to run against a non-local database host.
memories.keywords: seed demo data local accounts plans dashboard

memories.title: Plans and prices live in billing/catalog.yaml
memories.content: Plans and prices are defined in billing/catalog.yaml and pushed to Stripe Products and Prices with `make sync-catalog`. Never create a price in the Stripe dashboard by hand; the next sync archives it.
memories.keywords: plans prices catalog stripe products sync

memories.title: Metered guidebook views are reported to Stripe daily
memories.content: Usage-based plans report the previous day's guidebook views to Stripe as usage records shortly after midnight. A missed day is reported by the next run, because records are keyed by date.
memories.keywords: usage metered billing stripe usage records views daily

memories.title: Stripe sandbox tests are opt-in
memories.content: Tests that call the real Stripe sandbox are marked stripe_sandbox and are skipped unless STRIPE_SANDBOX_KEY is set. They run nightly in CI and never on pull requests.
memories.value_text: stripe_sandbox marker, skipped without a key
memories.keywords: stripe sandbox tests marker skip nightly ci

memories.title: CI requires 85% branch coverage of the billing package
memories.content: The coverage job fails when branch coverage of the billing package drops below 85%. Excluding a module needs a reason in the coverage config and a reviewer's approval.
memories.keywords: coverage branch threshold ci pytest-cov exclude

memories.title: Issued PDFs are never re-rendered
memories.content: Each stored PDF records the template_version it was rendered with. A template change bumps TEMPLATE_VERSION, and only invoices that are still drafts get re-rendered; issued PDFs stay byte-identical.
memories.value_text: only drafts re-rendered on template change
memories.keywords: pdf template version regenerate render issued draft

memories.title: Development e-mails are written to tmp/mail
memories.content: Outside production the mail backend writes every message as an .eml file to tmp/mail instead of sending it. Open the files in any mail client to check a template.
memories.keywords: email development eml files mail backend local

memories.title: Accounts with unpaid invoices cannot be closed
memories.content: close_account returns 409 Conflict while the account has open or overdue invoices. Support must settle or void them first; deleting rows by hand breaks the ledger.
memories.keywords: close account unpaid invoices conflict support void

memories.title: Renovate opens grouped dependency updates every Monday
memories.content: Renovate opens one grouped pull request for minor and patch updates every Monday morning, and security fixes get their own pull request immediately. Major upgrades wait for a ticket.
memories.keywords: renovate dependency updates pull request security patch

memories.title: Shared request dependencies live in billing/api/deps.py
memories.content: Database sessions, the current account and the Stripe client are provided through FastAPI Depends functions in billing/api/deps.py. Tests override them with app.dependency_overrides instead of patching modules.
memories.keywords: fastapi depends dependency injection session override tests

memories.title: PDF worker memory spikes are probably large logos (unconfirmed)
memories.content: The memory spikes of the PDF workers are probably caused by customers uploading logos larger than 5 MB, which are embedded unscaled. Nobody has profiled a render yet, so this is a guess.
memories.keywords: memory spike pdf worker logo image profile hypothesis

memories.title: Slow webhook responses after deploys are probably cold connections (unconfirmed)
memories.content: Webhook handlers answer slowly for a few minutes after each deploy, most likely because the connection pool starts empty. This has not been measured; it is an assumption from the latency graphs.
memories.keywords: webhook latency slow deploy connection pool hypothesis

memories.title: 2026-01 incident: open redirect through the portal return URL
memories.content: In January 2026 a security researcher showed that the portal-session endpoint accepted any return_url, which allowed phishing redirects. The fix added PORTAL_RETURN_URL_ALLOWLIST and a test for foreign hosts.
memories.keywords: incident open redirect portal return_url allowlist security

memories.title: 2026-02 incident: VAT treatment from a stale customer country
memories.content: In February 2026 several invoices used the VAT treatment of the customer's previous country because the account address changed after the draft was created. Invoices now snapshot the billing address and country at finalization.
memories.value_text: address and country snapshot at finalization
memories.keywords: incident vat country address snapshot finalization

memories.title: 2026-05 incident: stacked coupons produced zero-value invoices
memories.content: In May 2026 a promo campaign let customers apply two coupons to one subscription, and some invoices came out at zero. The API now rejects a second coupon with a validation error.
memories.keywords: incident coupon discount stacking zero invoice promo

memories.title: Prefer SQLAlchemy 2.0 select() style
memories.content: The team prefers SQLAlchemy 2.0 style with select() and session.scalars() over the legacy Query API. Old session.query calls are migrated when a module is touched anyway.
memories.keywords: sqlalchemy select query style orm legacy

memories.title: Pydantic schemas use Create, Update and Read suffixes
memories.content: Request and response models are named like InvoiceCreate, InvoiceUpdate and InvoiceRead and live in billing/schemas. The team prefers separate models over optional fields on one shared model.
memories.keywords: pydantic schema model naming request response

memories.title: Add a towncrier fragment for user-visible changes
memories.content: User-visible changes need a news fragment such as changes/BILL-412.feature.md or .bugfix.md; towncrier builds the changelog at release time. Internal refactors need no fragment.
memories.keywords: changelog towncrier fragment release notes

memories.title: Load tests run k6 against staging only
memories.content: Load tests use the k6 scripts in loadtest/ and run against staging with `make loadtest SCENARIO=invoice-list`. Never point them at production, because the Stripe rate limits are shared with live traffic.
memories.keywords: load test k6 staging performance scenario

memories.title: Preview an invoice layout with make preview-invoice
memories.content: `make preview-invoice ID=<invoice id>` renders the invoice to tmp/preview.pdf with the current templates without storing anything. Use it when changing the invoice layout.
memories.keywords: invoice preview pdf layout template render

memories.title: Use pnpm, never npm or yarn
memories.content: guidebook-web uses pnpm 9 with a committed pnpm-lock.yaml. Running npm install creates a package-lock.json that breaks the CI cache key and must not be committed.
memories.keywords: pnpm npm yarn install lockfile package manager

memories.title: Builds run on Node 22
memories.content: The app builds and runs its tooling on Node 22, pinned in .nvmrc and in the Vercel project settings. The Vite 6 plugins used here fail on Node 18.
memories.keywords: node version nvmrc runtime vite

memories.title: Run unit tests with pnpm test:unit (Vitest)
memories.content: Run unit and component tests with `pnpm test:unit`, which is Vitest in jsdom. Component tests mount with @vue/test-utils and stub the router instead of starting it.
memories.keywords: vitest unit tests component test-utils jsdom

memories.title: E2E tests run Playwright against the preview build
memories.content: Run `pnpm build` and then `pnpm test:e2e`; the Playwright tests run against `pnpm preview` on port 4173. Skipping the build makes the tests hit a stale bundle.
memories.keywords: playwright e2e end-to-end preview build port 4173

memories.title: Deploys run through Vercel
memories.content: Every push gets a Vercel preview URL, and production deploys only on merge to main. Environment variables live in the Vercel project, not in committed .env files.
memories.keywords: deploy vercel preview production environment variables

memories.title: Components use script setup and the Composition API
memories.content: New components use <script setup lang='ts'> with the Composition API. The Options API is not allowed in new or rewritten components.
memories.value_text: script setup with the Composition API
memories.keywords: vue component script setup composition api options api

memories.title: Shared state lives in Pinia setup stores
memories.content: Shared state lives in Pinia setup stores under src/stores, and components change it only through store actions. Mutating store state directly from components broke devtools time travel and SSR hydration.
memories.keywords: pinia store state actions vuex

memories.title: All UI text goes through vue-i18n keys
memories.content: Every user-facing string uses a vue-i18n key from src/locales/*.json. English is the source locale; translators own the cs, de and fr files.
memories.keywords: i18n translation locale strings vue-i18n czech german french

memories.title: Call the backend only through the generated OpenAPI client
memories.content: Backend calls go through the OpenAPI-generated client in src/api/generated. After a backend schema change, run `pnpm api:generate`; never edit the generated files by hand.
memories.keywords: api client openapi generated fetch backend schema

memories.title: Styling uses Tailwind classes mapped to design tokens
memories.content: Style components with Tailwind utility classes mapped to the design tokens in tailwind.config.ts. Raw hex colours in components fail review.
memories.keywords: css tailwind styling colors design tokens

memories.title: Interactive elements need accessible names and keyboard support
memories.content: Every interactive element needs an accessible name and full keyboard support. The axe check in CI fails the build on serious violations.
memories.keywords: accessibility a11y aria keyboard axe screen reader

memories.title: Guide photos are served through the imgproxy CDN
memories.content: Guide photos are served through the imgproxy CDN with a width-based srcset. Original S3 URLs must never appear in templates because the originals are up to 12 MB.
memories.keywords: images photos cdn imgproxy srcset s3 performance

memories.title: Guides work offline through the service worker
memories.content: Guests often open guides on poor Wi-Fi, so the service worker (vite-plugin-pwa, injectManifest) caches the guide JSON and images. Bump CACHE_VERSION in src/sw.ts whenever the guide schema changes.
memories.keywords: offline service worker pwa cache wifi

memories.title: Never rename a guide slug; add a redirect
memories.content: Public guide routes are /g/:slug/:section, and slugs are printed in QR codes. Never rename a slug; add a redirect entry instead.
memories.keywords: route slug url rename redirect router qr

memories.title: Run pnpm lint and pnpm typecheck before pushing
memories.content: Run `pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck` before pushing; it runs eslint with the flat config and vue-tsc --noEmit. CI runs both and blocks the merge on errors.
memories.keywords: eslint lint typecheck vue-tsc

memories.title: Guide list search is debounced 250 ms and aborts stale requests
memories.content: The guide list search input is debounced by 250 ms and aborts the previous request with an AbortController. Removing the abort once let stale results overwrite newer ones.
memories.keywords: search debounce abortcontroller stale results guide list

memories.title: Maps use MapLibre with self-hosted tiles
memories.content: Maps render with MapLibre GL and the self-hosted vector tiles at tiles.guidebook.example. Google Maps was dropped in 2025 because of its per-load pricing.
memories.keywords: map maps maplibre tiles google maps

memories.title: Analytics load only after consent
memories.content: Plausible analytics loads only after the guest accepts the consent banner. No analytics event may fire before consent.
memories.keywords: analytics plausible consent cookie banner gdpr tracking

memories.title: Only VITE_ variables reach the client; never prefix secrets
memories.content: Only environment variables prefixed with VITE_ are bundled into the client. A secret must never use the VITE_ prefix because it would ship to every guest's browser.
memories.keywords: env environment variables vite secret client bundle

memories.title: Format dates in the property's timezone
memories.content: Format dates with date-fns and date-fns-tz in the property's timezone, not in the guest's browser timezone. Check-in times belong to the property.
memories.keywords: date time timezone date-fns check-in format

memories.title: PrimeVue runs in unstyled mode with a Tailwind preset
memories.content: UI primitives come from PrimeVue in unstyled mode with our Tailwind pass-through preset. Importing a PrimeVue theme overrides the tokens and is not allowed.
memories.keywords: primevue components ui library unstyled theme passthrough

memories.title: New shared components need a Storybook story
memories.content: Every new shared component gets a story in a .stories.ts file next to it under src/components. Run `pnpm storybook` to open it on port 6006.
memories.keywords: storybook stories component documentation

memories.title: Initial bundle budget is 180 kB gzip
memories.content: The initial route bundle must stay under 180 kB gzipped, enforced by size-limit in CI. Lazy-load the map and the photo gallery to stay under it.
memories.keywords: bundle size budget size-limit lazy load performance

memories.title: The printable guide uses /g/:slug/print and print.css
memories.content: The printable guide is rendered by the /g/:slug/print route with print.css. Check layout changes in the Chrome print preview, which is what hosts use.
memories.keywords: print printable pdf stylesheet print.css

memories.title: Host editor auth uses httpOnly cookies, never localStorage
memories.content: The host editor authenticates with an httpOnly session cookie set by the backend. Never store tokens in localStorage or sessionStorage.
memories.keywords: auth login session cookie token localstorage host editor

memories.title: The editor autosaves after 5 seconds and serializes saves
memories.content: The guide editor autosaves drafts after 5 seconds of inactivity and on blur. Saves are serialized so an older response can never overwrite a newer draft.
memories.keywords: autosave editor draft save debounce race

memories.title: 2026-07 incident: blank page after a deploy
memories.content: In July 2026 guests saw a blank page after a deploy because the service worker served an old index.html that referenced deleted chunks. The fix was skipWaiting with a reload prompt.
memories.keywords: blank page deploy service worker chunks index.html incident

memories.title: 2026-09 incident: wrong Czech plural forms
memories.content: In September 2026 Czech guides showed wrong plural forms such as '5 noci' because the cs locale used the English plural rule. vue-i18n now has a custom pluralRules entry for cs.
memories.keywords: czech plural pluralization i18n locale noci

memories.title: Branch from develop; release to main every second Tuesday
memories.content: In guidebook-web, feature branches start from develop and merge back into develop. A release merges develop into main every second Tuesday.
memories.keywords: branch develop main release gitflow merge

memories.title: commitlint enforces Conventional Commits
memories.content: The husky commit-msg hook runs commitlint with the Conventional Commits preset. The release notes generator groups entries by feat and fix, so a wrong type hides the change.
memories.keywords: commit message commitlint husky conventional release notes

memories.title: Frontend errors go to Sentry tagged with the release SHA
memories.content: Frontend errors are reported to Sentry with the release set to the Vercel git SHA. Source maps are uploaded during the build and then removed from the deployed output.
memories.keywords: sentry error tracking source maps release

memories.title: Forms validate with vee-validate and shared zod schemas
memories.content: Editor forms use vee-validate with the zod schemas shared from src/schemas. Hand-rolled validation inside components is rejected in review.
memories.keywords: form validation zod vee-validate schema input

memories.title: Avoid snapshot tests
memories.content: The guidebook team rejects new snapshot tests. Assert the visible text and the emitted events instead.
memories.keywords: snapshot tests toMatchSnapshot assertions

memories.title: Slow first paint is probably caused by font loading (unconfirmed)
memories.content: The slow first contentful paint on guide pages is probably caused by the two self-hosted variable fonts blocking render. This is a hypothesis from one Lighthouse run and has not been measured properly.
memories.keywords: performance first paint fcp fonts lighthouse slow

memories.title: QR codes encode short links, not guide URLs
memories.content: Printed QR codes encode short links like https://gbk.example/s/<slug> that redirect to the guide. A domain change therefore never breaks printed material.
memories.keywords: qr code short link printed redirect domain

memories.title: Route views are loaded with dynamic imports
memories.content: Every route in src/router/index.ts imports its view with a dynamic import, so each page becomes its own chunk. Only the guide shell layout is imported eagerly.
memories.keywords: router lazy load dynamic import chunk route view

memories.title: Composables are named useSomething, one per file
memories.content: Composables live in src/composables, one per file, named useSomething. They return refs and functions rather than a reactive object, so callers can destructure them safely.
memories.value_text: useSomething, one per file, returns refs
memories.keywords: composable use function refs reactive destructure naming

memories.title: Page titles and meta tags are set with useHead
memories.content: Each view sets its title, description and Open Graph tags with useHead from @unhead/vue. Guide pages use the guide's cover photo as og:image, so shared links show a preview.
memories.keywords: meta title open graph og image head share preview

memories.title: Guide sections are edited with Tiptap
memories.content: Hosts write guide sections in a Tiptap editor limited to headings, lists, links and images. Pasted HTML is sanitized with DOMPurify before it is stored.
memories.keywords: rich text editor tiptap paste sanitize dompurify html

memories.title: Host HTML is rendered only through SafeHtml
memories.content: Rendering host content with v-html is allowed only inside the SafeHtml component, which runs DOMPurify with the guide allowlist. The vue/no-v-html rule is enabled everywhere else.
memories.keywords: v-html xss sanitize dompurify safe html component

memories.title: Guest language comes from ?lang, the browser, then the guide default
memories.content: The guest view picks its language from the ?lang query parameter, then navigator.languages, then the guide's default language. The choice is kept in a lang cookie for 30 days.
memories.keywords: language locale detection guest browser cookie query

memories.title: Hosts translate guide content themselves
memories.content: Guide content is translated section by section by the host; the editor can prefill a machine suggestion that the backend fetches from DeepL. Interface labels are a separate concern handled by the product team.
memories.keywords: translation guide content host deepl machine section language

memories.title: Frontend feature flags are fetched once at startup
memories.content: The app fetches the enabled feature flags from the backend's /api/flags endpoint once at startup and exposes them through useFlag(). Flags never change during a session.
memories.keywords: feature flags toggle startup useflag backend

memories.title: Each route view renders inside an ErrorBoundary
memories.content: Route views render inside the ErrorBoundary component, which shows a retry card instead of an empty view when a child component throws. Do not add try/catch blocks around template rendering.
memories.keywords: error boundary retry view component throw

memories.title: API requests fail after 15 seconds
memories.content: The request wrapper in src/api/request.ts fails requests after 15 seconds and retries idempotent GETs once. Mutations are never retried automatically.
memories.keywords: request timeout retry get mutation wrapper

memories.title: Optimistic updates only for simple toggles
memories.content: The editor applies optimistic updates only to simple toggles such as publishing a section, and rolls them back when the request fails. Content edits wait for the server response.
memories.keywords: optimistic update rollback toggle editor publish

memories.title: Guide changes stay private until the host publishes
memories.content: Edits go into a draft revision that only the host sees; guests see the last published revision until the host presses Publish. Publishing creates an immutable revision used for rollbacks.
memories.keywords: publish draft revision guest host rollback

memories.title: Door codes and Wi-Fi passwords sit behind a booking PIN
memories.content: Sections marked private, such as door codes and Wi-Fi passwords, are fetched only after the guest enters the booking PIN. They are never part of the public guide response.
memories.keywords: private section pin door code wifi password guest booking

memories.title: New guides start from section templates
memories.content: A new guide is created from the section templates in src/guide/templates, such as check-in, house rules and local tips. Changing a template does not touch existing guides.
memories.keywords: template section house rules check-in new guide

memories.title: Photo uploads accept JPEG, PNG, HEIC and WebP up to 20 MB
memories.content: The editor accepts JPEG, PNG, HEIC and WebP photos up to 20 MB per file and uploads them with a presigned POST. HEIC files are converted on the server.
memories.keywords: photo upload image size format heic presigned

memories.title: The photo gallery opens images in PhotoSwipe
memories.content: The guest photo gallery opens images in a PhotoSwipe lightbox with swipe gestures. Thumbnails in the grid are square crops chosen by the host.
memories.keywords: gallery photos lightbox photoswipe swipe thumbnails

memories.title: Dark mode follows the system setting
memories.content: The guest view follows prefers-color-scheme and sets the dark class on the html element; there is no manual toggle. Every new component must be checked in both schemes.
memories.keywords: dark mode color scheme theme prefers-color-scheme

memories.title: Guest pages are designed for phones first
memories.content: Guest pages are designed for phones first; the sm and lg breakpoints only widen the layout for tablets and desktops. Check new guest components at 360 px width.
memories.keywords: responsive mobile first breakpoints layout phone width

memories.title: The weather card reads a backend proxy
memories.content: The weather card calls the backend's /api/weather proxy, which caches forecasts for 30 minutes per property. The card hides itself when the proxy returns no data.
memories.keywords: weather widget forecast proxy cache property

memories.title: Local tips use the backend places search
memories.content: The local recommendations section searches places through the backend's /api/places endpoint, which wraps the Placely API. Results are stored in the guide, so they do not change after publishing.
memories.keywords: places recommendations local tips search provider

memories.title: Map markers cluster above 50 points
memories.content: The guide map clusters markers when a guide has more than 50 points of interest, otherwise phones stutter while panning. Marker icons are drawn from one sprite sheet, not as DOM elements.
memories.keywords: map markers cluster points of interest performance sprite

memories.title: Hosts download QR codes as SVG or a 2048 px PNG
memories.content: The share dialog offers the guide's QR code as SVG for print shops and as a 2048 px PNG for everything else. Both files are generated in the browser with the qrcode package.
memories.keywords: qr code download svg png print share dialog

memories.title: Only the marketing pages are prerendered
memories.content: The landing and pricing pages are prerendered at build time with vite-ssg, while guide pages stay client-rendered. Do not add guide routes to the prerender list.
memories.keywords: prerender ssg landing pricing pages build

memories.title: Tests mock HTTP with MSW handlers
memories.content: Component and store tests mock backend calls with the MSW handlers in src/mocks/handlers.ts instead of stubbing modules. An unhandled request fails the test.
memories.keywords: msw mock http handlers tests requests

memories.title: E2E selectors use roles first and data-testid as a fallback
memories.content: Playwright tests locate elements by role and accessible name first and fall back to data-testid. CSS class selectors are not allowed because styling classes change often.
memories.keywords: playwright selectors role testid locator

memories.title: E2E specs reset data through the test API
memories.content: Each Playwright spec calls the backend's /test-api/reset endpoint in beforeEach to load the demo host and two guides. The endpoint exists only in the staging and CI environments.
memories.keywords: test data reset seed playwright fixture demo host

memories.title: Editor routes are guarded by the requiresHost meta flag
memories.content: Routes under /editor carry meta.requiresHost, and the global beforeEach guard sends visitors without a host session back to the guide list. Never repeat that check inside individual views.
memories.value_text: requiresHost meta with a global guard
memories.keywords: router guard editor redirect meta beforeEach

memories.title: Mutating requests send the CSRF token header
memories.content: Every POST, PUT, PATCH and DELETE request copies the csrf_token cookie into the X-CSRF-Token header. The backend answers 403 when the header is missing.
memories.keywords: csrf token header cookie post request security

memories.title: Host editor sessions expire after 12 idle hours
memories.content: An editor session expires after 12 hours without activity, and any request resets the timer. An expired session opens the login dialog without losing the unsaved draft.
memories.keywords: session expiry idle login dialog editor host

memories.title: Analytics event names come from one catalogue
memories.content: Every analytics event name is defined once in src/analytics/events.ts in snake_case, such as section_opened. Ad-hoc event strings in components fail review.
memories.keywords: analytics events naming catalogue tracking snake_case

memories.title: The cover photo loads with high fetch priority
memories.content: The guide cover photo is the largest contentful paint element, so it is rendered with fetchpriority=high and without lazy loading. Every other image on the page is lazy.
memories.keywords: lcp cover photo fetchpriority lazy loading

memories.title: Supported browsers are the last two versions and Safari 15+
memories.content: The browserslist config targets the last two versions of evergreen browsers and Safari 15 or newer, because many guests use older iPhones. Features outside that range need a fallback.
memories.keywords: browserslist browser support safari iphone targets

memories.title: Feature code lives in src/features/<feature>
memories.content: Code that belongs to one feature, such as the share dialog or the guest view, lives in src/features/<feature> with its own components and tests. Only code used by two features moves to src/components or src/utils.
memories.keywords: folder structure features components utils layout

memories.title: The @ alias points to src
memories.content: Imports use the @ alias for src, configured in vite.config.ts and tsconfig.json. Relative imports may climb at most one directory; deeper ../../ chains fail the import rule.
memories.keywords: import alias path src relative tsconfig vite

memories.title: Local settings go into .env.local
memories.content: Copy .env.example to .env.local for development; .env.local is git-ignored and overrides .env. Never edit .env for personal settings.
memories.keywords: env file local development dotenv personal settings

memories.title: The dev server proxies /api to the local backend
memories.content: vite.config.ts proxies /api to http://localhost:8000 during development, so requests stay same-origin. Set API_PROXY_TARGET to point the proxy at staging instead.
memories.keywords: dev server proxy api localhost backend staging

memories.title: The guest view never asks to be installed
memories.content: The guest view suppresses the beforeinstallprompt event, because guests use a guide for only a few days. Do not add an install button.
memories.keywords: install prompt beforeinstallprompt guest home screen

memories.title: 2026-04 incident: map pins in the wrong country
memories.content: In April 2026 an import swapped latitude and longitude for a batch of properties, so their guide maps showed the pin in the wrong country. The editor now rejects coordinates outside the property's country bounding box.
memories.value_text: coordinates checked against the country bounding box
memories.keywords: incident map pin coordinates latitude longitude swapped

memories.title: 2026-02 incident: Safari 15 date inputs broke the stay form
memories.content: In February 2026 hosts on Safari 15 could not set stay dates because the native date input returned an empty value. The editor now uses the shared DatePicker component everywhere.
memories.value_text: shared DatePicker instead of the native input
memories.keywords: incident safari date input picker stay form

memories.title: 2026-06 incident: raw labels shown to German guests
memories.content: In June 2026 German guests saw raw labels such as section.wifi.title because a release added new strings without German entries. The UI now falls back to English, and CI fails when a locale misses an entry.
memories.value_text: English fallback and a CI completeness check
memories.keywords: incident translation german fallback missing locale

memories.title: Typing lag in long guides is probably a deep watcher (unconfirmed)
memories.content: Typing in guides with more than 40 sections feels laggy, probably because a deep watcher on the whole guide document re-runs on every keystroke. Nobody has profiled it yet.
memories.value_text: deep watcher on the guide document (hypothesis)
memories.keywords: performance typing lag editor watcher deep hypothesis

memories.title: Prefer components under about 200 lines
memories.content: The team prefers splitting a component that grows past about 200 lines into child components. Large single-file components are hard to review.
memories.keywords: component size split review single file

memories.title: Component names are multi-word PascalCase
memories.content: Components use multi-word PascalCase names such as GuideSectionCard, and base components start with Base. Single-word names clash with HTML elements.
memories.keywords: component naming pascalcase multi-word base

memories.title: Hosts preview unpublished guides with ?preview=1
memories.content: Opening a guide URL with ?preview=1 while logged in as its host shows the draft revision instead of the published one. Visitors without a host session still get the published guide.
memories.keywords: preview draft unpublished host guide url

memories.title: Inspect bundle contents with the build:analyze script
memories.content: The build:analyze script builds the app with rollup-plugin-visualizer and opens stats.html. Use it to find which dependency pulled code into a chunk.
memories.keywords: bundle analyze visualizer chunk dependency stats

memories.title: Run the frontend without a backend using mock:dev
memories.content: The mock:dev script starts Vite with the MSW browser worker enabled, so every API call is answered by the handlers in src/mocks. Use it for UI work when the backend is not running.
memories.value_text: mock:dev with the MSW browser worker
memories.keywords: mock api msw dev server without backend

memories.title: No third-party widgets on guest pages
memories.content: Guest pages load no third-party widgets such as chat bubbles or tag managers; integrations go through the backend instead. This keeps guest pages light and avoids sharing guest data with vendors.
memories.keywords: third party scripts chat widget tag manager privacy

memories.title: The guide list loads 24 guides per page
memories.content: The host's guide list fetches 24 guides per page and loads the next page when the sentinel element becomes visible. Changing the sort order resets the list to the first page.
memories.keywords: guide list pagination infinite scroll page size sort

memories.title: Hosts send guides to guests from the share dialog
memories.content: The share dialog copies the guide link or sends it by e-mail or WhatsApp. E-mails are sent by the backend under the host's verified sender name.
memories.keywords: share dialog link email whatsapp guest

memories.title: Test names read as behaviour sentences
memories.content: The team prefers test names that describe a behaviour, such as 'shows the Wi-Fi password after the PIN is entered', over names that repeat the function name. One behaviour per test.
memories.keywords: test names behaviour describe it readability

memories.title: Toolchain is Go 1.23
memories.content: The pipeline builds with Go 1.23, pinned by the toolchain line in go.mod. Range-over-func iterators are allowed; nothing newer is.
memories.keywords: go golang version toolchain go.mod

memories.title: Run tests with go test -race ./...
memories.content: Run unit tests with `go test -race ./...`; the race detector is mandatory because the consumers share batch buffers between goroutines. CI uses the same flags.
memories.keywords: go test race tests unit detector

memories.title: Lint with golangci-lint before pushing
memories.content: Run `golangci-lint run ./...` with the repository's .golangci.yml before pushing. CI fails on any finding, including errcheck.
memories.keywords: lint golangci-lint errcheck vet staticcheck

memories.title: Booking events arrive on Kafka topic bookings.v2
memories.content: Booking events arrive on the Kafka topic bookings.v2 with 24 partitions. The consumer group is ingest-bookings, and offsets are committed only after the ClickHouse insert succeeds.
memories.keywords: kafka topic consumer group offsets bookings partitions

memories.title: Analytics warehouse is ClickHouse with ReplacingMergeTree
memories.content: Normalized events land in the ClickHouse table bookings_raw, a ReplacingMergeTree keyed by event_id. Queries must use FINAL or argMax because duplicates exist until background merges run.
memories.keywords: clickhouse warehouse replacingmergetree final argmax duplicates query

memories.title: Avro schemas evolve with BACKWARD compatibility
memories.content: Message schemas are Avro files registered in the schema registry with BACKWARD compatibility. Add new fields only with defaults and never rename a field.
memories.keywords: avro schema registry compatibility field default

memories.title: Wrap errors with %w and context; never log and return
memories.content: Wrap returned errors with fmt.Errorf, the %w verb and context such as the booking id. Never discard an error with _ and never both log and return the same error.
memories.keywords: error handling wrap fmt.Errorf errors.Is

memories.title: context.Context comes first and cancellation is honoured
memories.content: Every function that does I/O takes ctx context.Context as its first parameter and returns when ctx is done. Graceful consumer shutdown depends on it.
memories.keywords: context cancellation ctx shutdown goroutine

memories.title: Poison messages go to bookings.v2.dlq; replay with make replay-dlq
memories.content: Messages that fail validation three times are moved to bookings.v2.dlq with the error in a header. Replay them with `make replay-dlq TOPIC=bookings.v2.dlq` after fixing the parser.
memories.keywords: dead letter queue dlq poison message replay

memories.title: Runs on Kubernetes via Helm, synced by Argo CD
memories.content: The pipeline runs on the data Kubernetes cluster from the Helm chart in deploy/chart. Argo CD syncs main automatically, so merging is deploying.
memories.value_text: Kubernetes with Helm and Argo CD
memories.keywords: deploy kubernetes helm argo cd chart cluster

memories.title: Configuration comes only from INGEST_* environment variables
memories.content: Configuration is loaded with envconfig from INGEST_* environment variables in internal/config. There are no config files, and packages never call os.Getenv themselves.
memories.keywords: config configuration environment variables envconfig getenv

memories.title: Log with the log/slog JSON handler
memories.content: Log with log/slog through the JSON handler and the request-scoped logger taken from the context. zap was removed in 2025; do not reintroduce it.
memories.keywords: logging slog zap json logger

memories.title: Prometheus metrics on :9090; lag alert above 50k for 10 minutes
memories.content: Each worker exposes Prometheus metrics on :9090/metrics. The consumer lag alert fires when lag stays above 50k messages for 10 minutes.
memories.keywords: prometheus metrics alert consumer lag monitoring grafana

memories.title: Integration tests need the integration build tag
memories.content: Integration tests in internal/it start Kafka and ClickHouse with testcontainers-go and only build with the integration tag: `go test -tags integration ./internal/it/...`. Docker must be running.
memories.keywords: integration tests testcontainers docker build tag

memories.title: Regenerate mocks with go generate; never edit mocks/
memories.content: Mocks are generated by mockery v2 from .mockery.yaml via `go generate ./...`. Hand edits in mocks/ are overwritten on the next generation.
memories.keywords: mocks mockery go generate interface test double

memories.title: Sinks are idempotent by event_id
memories.content: Kafka delivers at least once, so every sink deduplicates by event_id. Never use auto-increment ids for events.
memories.keywords: idempotent at least once duplicate event_id sink

memories.title: Channel manager adapters: HarborPMS, Roomlynx and Nestify
memories.content: Adapters for the HarborPMS, Roomlynx and Nestify channel managers live in internal/adapters. Each adapter maps its partner payload to the canonical BookingEvent.
memories.keywords: adapter channel manager partner integration harborpms roomlynx nestify

memories.title: Check-in and check-out are civil dates, never UTC timestamps
memories.content: Check-in and check-out are civil dates in the property's timezone and are parsed as civil.Date. Converting them to UTC timestamps shifted stays by one day.
memories.keywords: date timezone check-in check-out civil utc day shift

memories.title: Backfill with cmd/backfill at rate 200 against the replica
memories.content: Run historical backfills with `go run ./cmd/backfill --from 2026-01-01 --rate 200` against the read replica. The default rate overloads the partner APIs.
memories.keywords: backfill historical import rate limit replica

memories.title: Kafka partition key is property_id
memories.content: Events are partitioned by property_id so that updates for one property stay ordered. Changing the key reorders events during a rebalance.
memories.keywords: partition key ordering kafka property_id rebalance

memories.title: Partner API calls retry 5 times with exponential backoff and jitter
memories.content: Partner HTTP calls retry up to 5 times with exponential backoff starting at 500 ms and full jitter. HTTP 429 responses honour the Retry-After header.
memories.keywords: retry backoff jitter 429 retry-after partner api

memories.title: Packages live under internal/; cmd/ only wires
memories.content: Packages live under internal/ so other repositories cannot import them, and cmd/ only wires dependencies together. Business logic in cmd/ fails review.
memories.keywords: package layout internal cmd structure

memories.title: Use generics only when they remove real duplication
memories.content: The team prefers concrete types and adds a type parameter only when it removes duplicated logic. Generic helpers with a single caller get rejected.
memories.keywords: generics type parameter abstraction

memories.title: ClickHouse schema changes are goose migrations
memories.content: ClickHouse schema changes are goose migrations in migrations/clickhouse, applied with `make migrate-ch`. ALTERs on large tables must be ON CLUSTER and lightweight.
memories.keywords: migration goose clickhouse schema alter

memories.title: Prefer make targets over raw go commands
memories.content: `make build`, `make test`, `make lint` and `make run-local` wrap the Go commands with the right flags and build tags. Documentation and scripts reference the make targets.
memories.keywords: make makefile targets build

memories.title: Run locally with Redpanda and ClickHouse from docker compose
memories.content: Locally, `docker compose up redpanda clickhouse` replaces Kafka with Redpanda. Set INGEST_BROKERS=localhost:19092 before `make run-local`.
memories.value_text: docker compose with redpanda and clickhouse
memories.keywords: local development redpanda docker compose run locally brokers

memories.title: 2026-05 incident: 2M consumer lag from blocking inserts
memories.content: In May 2026 consumer lag reached 2 million messages because a slow ClickHouse insert blocked the poll loop. Inserts are now batched (5,000 rows or 1 s) in a separate goroutine.
memories.value_text: 5000 rows or 1 s in a separate goroutine
memories.keywords: consumer lag incident insert batching poll loop clickhouse

memories.title: 2026-03 incident: stays shifted by one day at DST
memories.content: At the March 2026 DST change, stays imported from Roomlynx shifted by one day because dates were parsed as UTC midnight. That incident is why stay dates are civil dates now.
memories.keywords: dst daylight saving incident date shift roomlynx

memories.title: Guest contact data is dropped or hashed before ClickHouse
memories.content: Guest names, e-mails and phone numbers are dropped or SHA-256 hashed with the tenant salt before anything is written to ClickHouse. Analytics never needs raw guest contact data.
memories.keywords: pii personal data guest email phone hash privacy gdpr

memories.title: Trunk-based: short branches, squash-merge to main
memories.content: ingest-pipeline uses trunk-based development: branches live less than two days and are squash-merged to main, which deploys immediately.
memories.keywords: branch trunk squash merge main

memories.title: Schema changes need an analytics team review
memories.content: The data platform team owns this repository, but changes under schemas/ need a review from the analytics team listed in CODEOWNERS.
memories.keywords: codeowners review owners schema analytics team

memories.title: Benchmark the parser before and after changes
